description: Read big output with the LOCAL model instead of reading it yourself: test runs, builds, logs, large files or diffs. It reads files and/or a command's output and answers your question. Only the short answer comes back, so large logs, files or diffs never enter your context. Good for: summarising a huge test log, finding where something is defined across big files, extracting numbers.

command.description: Shell command whose stdout+stderr is the material (e.g. a test run).

files.description: Paths relative to the git root (or cwd outside a repo).

model.description: Override the configured model for this call.

task.description: The question to answer from the material.

name: offload
